prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production sprite atlas for a 2D side-view fighting game, adapting the HOUND ONLY from these two official licensed Tracker Predator with Hound reference photographs. The photographs are design references only, not backgrounds or textures to copy. Draw the creature itself, never the humanoid Tracker, toy stands, lettering or chain. Preserve the 2010 Hound's identity: squat heavy quadruped with four sturdy reptilian legs and clawed feet, small dark eyes, enormous broad snout with a wide red toothed mouth, long ivory saber tusks from the cheeks, dark desaturated teal/olive pebbled scales and numerous very long ivory dorsal spikes. No dreadlocks, no human arms, no extra limbs, no fur, no ears, no saddle. Six separate full-body drawings in exactly THREE columns and TWO rows, equally sized rectangular grid cells; transparent background, NO visible grid lines or labels. Every drawing faces RIGHT in a strict side view, same physical body size and lighting. Entire spines, tail, claws and tusks safely inside its own cell with at least 8 percent transparent padding; no overlap across cells. Baseline feet at the same height within each cell. Cell order row-major: 1 alert idle weight on all four feet; 2 lowered telegraph crouch with open jaws, all four legs; 3 forward charge gait A, front legs reaching forward and rear legs pushing; 4 forward charge gait B, opposite planted legs with clear different limb articulation; 5 low forward bite lunge, red mouth opened wider, four anatomically coherent legs; 6 recoil/recovery stance with shoulders lowered and mouth closing. No rotation of camera between frames. Crisp highly readable painterly game sprite rendering, detailed restrained natural colors matching the reference, no photographic background or floor shadow. Transparent alpha around each of the SIX complete creatures. Large landscape atlas. Render right facing natively; not a visible flipped image from another atlas.
